quests.title: Whit Friday
quests.summary: Round up the village brass band, scattered over Saddleworth Moor, in time for the Whit Friday march contest.

steps.text: Find the cornet player moping by Dovestone Reservoir.
Find the tuba player lost on the Pennine Way, and show him a mountain hare.
Find the drummer on the boat trip through Standedge Tunnel.
Back to the Band Room, and beat the rival bandmaster in the march contest.

quests.reward: A Whit Friday Rosette, a Cornet Mouthpiece charm, Yorkshire curd tarts and standing in England.

quests.title: Don't Ask the Price
quests.summary: Gather three bits of Leeds for a display at Kirkgate Market, where Marks & Spencer began as a penny stall.

steps.text: Beat the armourer at the Royal Armouries, then ask the curator for a toy knight.
Ask the volunteer at Kirkstall Abbey for a fleece.
Ask the guide at the Thackray Museum of Medicine for an old pill tin.

quests.reward: A Penny Bazaar Tin, forced rhubarb, a Bobbin to keep and standing in England.

quests.title: The Brontë Trail
quests.summary: Walk a new visitors' trail round Haworth for the Brontë Parsonage, from the moor to the church vault.

steps.text: Walk the Brontë Way to Top Withens, beat the brooding lad there, and talk to the walker.
Hear Branwell's story from the landlord of the Black Bull.
Ask the verger at the church about the family vault.

quests.reward: Keeper's Collar charm, havercakes and standing in England.
